decisions.title: Bind successor health to MLB-specific deployment identity
decisions.reason: The global repository Git/template identity produced false MLB health mismatches after unrelated deployments. MLB health now binds to deterministic MLB executable/runtime identity while preserving fail-closed checks.

decisions.title: Fix Clean Row Final Label Time Validation
decisions.reason: The reported clean_row_final_label_time_invalid and clean_row_not_after_release_cutoff errors are expected on historical-training-only rows whose immutable bridge explicitly records labelObservationTimeUnavailable=true. Inventing or relaxing label times would weaken chronological evidence. Recent 2026-09-02, 2026-09-03, 2026-09-07, and 2026-09-09 slate proofs already achieve exact clean-slate equality with no such error.
decisions.reconsiderOnlyIf: The same error occurs on a current non-historical row that is expected to carry a genuine write-once label observation timestamp, or new evidence proves the historical bridge possesses an immutable real observation timestamp that is currently discarded.

decisions.title: Increase observed starter rate training data
decisions.reason: The accepted proposal attempted to count synthetic data augmentation and unspecified historical-window expansion toward observed starter-rate minima. The current StatsAPI starter adapter explicitly refuses historical reconstruction, and the retained completed-game/final-box corpora do not prove when target-game pregame starter observations were known. Those rows cannot be converted into observed pre-lock evidence without violating source honesty and chronology.
decisions.reconsiderOnlyIf: A verified immutable point-in-time pregame archive with exact game/starter identity, retrieval/effective timestamps, and payload provenance is available, or a current live pre-lock capture defect is demonstrated. Natural future source-honest accumulation remains valid.

decisions.title: Reduce Selected Reliability Calibration Error
decisions.reason: The proposal would adjust model outputs, apply Platt/isotonic calibration, and retrain while the same evidence states only 36 prospective selected recommendations exist versus the required 100. That prospective set is an incomplete holdout and cannot be used to choose or fit calibration behavior without leaking evaluation evidence.
decisions.reconsiderOnlyIf: The prospective selected-recommendation minimum is reached chronologically with immutable pregame predictions and settled labels, or the work is strictly read-only calibration diagnostics that do not tune, fit, select, or retrain a model.

decisions.title: Resolve Insufficient Clean Rows for Three-Way Chronological Split
decisions.reason: The proposal was driven by a nested retired-shadow audit section reporting only 5 rows, while the current R8 historical/live experiment already has 630 accepted rows with 308 train, 109 validation, and 102 prospective-test rows, exceeding the chronological split minima. Backfilling or augmenting data merely to satisfy the stale retired diagnostic would create false task authority and could compromise source honesty.
decisions.reconsiderOnlyIf: A current authoritative R8/successor training status again falls below the unchanged chronological row minima, with the deficit traced to a real source-honest admission or capture defect rather than a retired shadow diagnostic.
